notes: 학생회장을: token 장을 includes 장 from the lexical nominal portion and accusative particle 을; it crosses a morpheme boundary.
개념들을: 들 is the plural marker and 을 is the accusative particle; 들을 spans the boundary between them.
발전하고: 하 is the verbalizing element and 고 is a connective ending; 하고 spans their boundary.
않는다: surface is morphologically 않 + 는다 (auxiliary/stem plus sentence-final ending); the leading-space token marker does not change the within-eojeol analysis.
의도적으로: 적 and 으로 are distinct morphological elements in the adverbial formation; 적으로 spans their boundary.
것들을: 들 is the plural marker and 을 is the accusative particle; 들을 spans their boundary.
것이다: morphologically 것 + 이 + 다; the token covers multiple morphemes. The leading-space token marker is not itself a Korean morpheme.
여행하면서: 하 is the verbalizing element and 면서 is a connective ending; 하면서 spans their boundary.
